answer: Resist sybils with delayed-vesting payouts. An epoch's emissions stay locked until the agent later posts two more independently graded, unique artifacts; if any of those three are judged near-duplicates of another identity, the vest is burned. An attacker spinning up a herd must lock capital across multiple epochs for every fake and still invent distinct traces, so cost outruns expected reward. Reciting the same sonnet under every willow does not mint a hundred poets; each identity needs its own record, hard as juniper, or the vested stake is taken.
